newsitem.title: UK: New London warns on 1994 underwriting profits.
newsitem.headline: New London warns on 1994 underwriting profits.

text.p: New London Capital Plc said on Tuesday that a loss at Lloyd's of London Syndicate 657 would result in underwriting profits for the 1994 year of account to be in line with or possibly below the market average.

New London also said it anticipated that overall underwriting profitability for the Lloyd's market for 1994 would be reduced from previous estimates as a result of the strength of sterling against the U.S. dollar at the close of 1996.
Previous forecasts, using Syndicate Quarterly Reports, were based on a rate of $1.56 to the pound, compared with the rate at December 31 1996 of $1.71.

Non-marine Syndicate 657 reported a loss of 41 percent of capacity for the 1994 year and estimates a 1995 result of between 12.5 and 17.5 percent, but the figures are subject to considerable uncertainty.
The syndicate represents 7.1 percent of New London's total capacity for 1994.
